messages:
maya: Quick sync — propose final API shape for tool/function calls. Two options: explicit envelope vs function-style. Need streaming + structured output compatibility. High-level constraints: backwards-compatible, SDK-friendly, observable.
kevin: can you drop the two shapes? :eyes:
maya: Option A — explicit `tool_call` envelope (more structured)
```
{
  \"tool_call\": {
    \"name\": \"lookup_customer\",
    \"args\": { \"id\": \"1234\" },
    \"input_schema\": {\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}}}
  }
}
```
lina: Pros/cons?
maya: Pros: easy routing, explicit metadata, clear place for schema and provenance. Cons: extra envelope parsing, slightly more verbose for simple calls.
sam: Option B?
maya: Option B — `function_call` style (leaner, matches other provider conventions)
```
{
  \"type\": \"function_call\",
  \"name\": \"lookup_customer\",
  \"arguments\": \"{\\\"id\\\":\\\"1234\\\"}\"
}
```
kevin: B is simpler for client code, but how do we attach a typed schema? we need validation and tooling if we go with bare string args.
maya: Proposed hybrid: top-level `function_call` for ergonomics + optional `schema` or `schema_uri` for type hints/validation. Also define `tool_progress` / `tool_result` event types for streaming tools. Example:
```
{
  \"type\": \"function_call\",
  \"name\": \"long_rerank\",
  \"arguments\": { \"q\": \"...\" },
  \"schema\": {\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}}
}
```
lina: OK. Launch criteria?
maya: MVP launch criteria (prod gating):\n- Sync function_call semantics implemented in API and SDKs (unpack to native objects)\n- Optional inline schema accepted and validated in console (no enforcement by default)\n- Router supports fallback to a compatible model/tool when tool fails\n- Basic telemetry: call latency, failure mode, unwrap errors in traces\n- 3 customer example integrations in docs
Timeline: beta in ~4 weeks, GA after customer signoffs and 1 post-beta patch.
sam: Risks to call out?
kevin: Security: schema_uri must be authenticated (KMS/HSM or signed manifests) — otherwise arbitrary schema injection. Also tool args could be used for SSRF or file access in private tools. Need sandboxing + allowlist for tool endpoints.
lina: ML risks: rerank/long-running tools need streaming chunks and partial validation. We should define `tool_progress` with `chunk_index` + `partial_result` so downstream can render results progressively.
maya: Action items (owners):\n- eng (kevin): implement hybrid parser, SDK helpers to unpack `function_call` + optional schema, and fallback routing.\n- eng-ml (lina): define streaming `tool_progress` event format, perf sims for batching + long calls.\n- devex (sam): samples + quickstarts for: lookup_customer (simple), long_rerank (streaming), call-with-schema (typed).\n- product (maya): draft rollback plan, opt-out flags, and customer communication template.
kevin: I'll take parser + SDK. rough estimate: 1.5w for internal parser + unit tests, + 1w SDK updates.
lina: I'll prototype progress events and a microbench for streaming overhead. start today.
sam: Docs + samples: will convert 2 customer asks into examples and get them into repo.
maya: tagging customers for early feedback: @big-retailer, @finco (will DM them the proposal). also we should add acceptance tests: sample schema + expected canonical result vectors.
dev-bot: deploy scheduled: api/proto v0.18 -> staging tonight :robot_face:
kevin: :+1: sounds good. Agreement check — all thumbs?
lina: :+1: 
sam: :+1: 
maya: I'll follow up with a PR template and include a small example schema + test vectors. Thanks everyone.
